explanation: The Python harness start_prod.py was identified as the root cause of backend process deaths in the rejected run. When the backend is started directly with Node.exe (PID 9856) without the Python harness, it survives 10+ minutes of idle, executes test cases 002, 036, and 039 (the same cases that triggered crashes in the rejected run), and remains stable throughout.

python_harness_defects.issue: subprocess.PIPE with no communicate() or wait()
python_harness_defects.impact: Pipe buffers fill up, potentially causing SIGPIPE when Python exits
Children orphaned when Python script exits

python_harness_defects.issue: Script exits immediately after printing result
python_harness_defects.impact: No waiting for child processes, no zombie reaping
Different AI configuration may trigger different backend behavior
No persistent logs for debugging crashes

002.reason: UI element finance-mobile-navigation not found - application issue, not infrastructure
